notes.title: Update 1
notes.content:
Hi all,

Just rolled out a new update.  It contains some general housekeeping and bug fixes.  

- Fixed incorrect text on various units, abilities, and within the in-game manual
- Fixed a bug with the the price of reinforcement units on the Elimination game mode.
